## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the second Taishō recension (T0315b) of [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's *Pǔ mén pǐn jīng*, parallel to [T0315a](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0006). The two recensions preserve the same translation in slightly different states, with T0315b drawing on the Sòng (宋), Yuán (元), Palace (宮) and other witnesses rather than the Korean.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The two-recension preservation in the Taishō provides exceptional comparative-philological apparatus for studying the textual history of Zhú Fǎhù's translation work.

The Taishō text (T0315b) is established on the standard non-Korean witnesses.
